description_expanded: Be close to everything Alys Beach has to offer in this ideally located 5 bedroom, 5.5 bath vacation rental. Lounge in luxury in a courtyard featuring Washingtonia palms, plunge pool, shaded loggia, and a cozy seating area. There are 3 spacious bedrooms and a versatile study for family fun or quiet reading on the second floor. As you would expect from an Alys Beach rental, the kitchen is a showcase of top-of-the-line appliances and granite surfaces. Always accommodating, this beach rental includes a private guest suite off the main house. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
